name: zurich-altstadt
description: Zurich old town on both banks of the Limmat, about 0.98 x 0.97 km: the largest WGS84 rectangle inside the LV95 kilometre square E 2683-2684 / N 1247-1248, so it needs one swissBUILDINGS3D sheet and one swissALTI3D tile.
places_source: Positions from OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL: centres of the named squares and streets; Grossmuensterplatz is the fixture spawn on the square, facing the church. The client's travel keys 1-9 go to them in this order.
